scope: Character-memory capabilities, their interfaces and supporting machinery; independent labs are registered as adjacent features. Not a file-by-file audit or deployed-state certification.

entries.name: Prompt and persona authoring
entries.input: Reviewed character-specific prompt/persona edits
entries.output: Active authored characterization including behavioral tendencies; edits update active content, with immutable execution versions created by CHAR-02
entries.evidence: Content ownership and identity tests exist; characterization quality is a separate judgment.
entries.gap: A stored persona is not proof that models enact it consistently; ADE-wide rules are not personality attributes.
entries.next_check: Review coherent, distinguishable authored intent and character-specific contrasts, not a universal agreeable-assistant ideal (PC-12).

entries.name: Immutable definition binding
entries.input: Active prompt/persona content and deployment/tool/policy configuration for snapshot creation; selected immutable version and subject for conversation binding
entries.output: Immutable definition snapshot and conversation binding; later active edits do not change an existing conversation's version
entries.evidence: Definition/conversation mechanics and isolated version journeys are documented; ordinary version changes keep the character root (PC-03/04).
entries.gap: Version-binding mechanics do not qualify cross-version story continuity.
entries.next_check: Trace the same character root through two versions with fixed historical evidence.

entries.name: Evidence interpretation
entries.input: Current exchange, bound characterization and actual delivered evidence with scope and qualifications
entries.output: Situational and evidence interpretation with warranted uncertainty within shared generation; no emitted intermediate or handoff
entries.evidence: D04 has bounded supported-answer and appropriate-uncertainty witnesses; no general interpretation certificate. Shares generation with CHAR-04; descriptions distinguish responsibilities, not internal stages (PC-12).
entries.gap: Situational references, antecedents, ambiguity and correction qualifications are not generally qualified.
entries.next_check: Verify actual persona/evidence delivery and semantic sufficiency, then describe observable grounding outcomes without claiming an isolated internal failure.

entries.name: Character expression and continuity
entries.input: Authored characterization, current exchange, scoped evidence and ADE-wide requirements within the same generation as CHAR-03
entries.output: Observable candidate reply: choose an appropriate conversational action and express it in character, including continuity; not a style-only pass
entries.evidence: Shares the generation call with CHAR-03; story probes do not establish broad judgment, naturalness or personality quality. PC-12 clarifies assessment, not implementation or qualification.
entries.gap: Character-relative conversational choices, distinct voice, non-repetitive memory use and long-run story continuity remain behavioral work.
entries.next_check: Assess grounding, conversational judgment and character fidelity separately on verified, sufficient inputs; cite persona intention, response passage and context, allowing multiple good or indeterminate outcomes (PC-11/12).

entries.name: Curated tool choice and result use
entries.input: Available curated tools and model-issued arguments
entries.output: Validated invocation and actual result fed back to generation
entries.evidence: Finite loop and structured tool contracts have tests; memory search remains a Memory capability even when tool-invoked.
entries.gap: Discretionary tool choice is not guaranteed by transport conformance.
entries.next_check: Check appropriate invocation and truthful use of failed, empty and successful results.

entries.name: Scope and eligibility
entries.input: Workspace, subject, character root, purpose and lifecycle state
entries.output: Eligible current facts and scoped original exchanges
entries.evidence: Fact isolation has code; historical reader is development/evaluation-bound. Facts and experiences have different scope (PC-02/03/10).
entries.gap: Archived/versioned history eligibility is not general released historical recall.
entries.next_check: Inspect inclusion and exclusion receipts across user, root, version, archive and lifecycle boundaries.

entries.name: Candidate search
entries.input: Eligible state and current query
entries.output: Potentially relevant facts and original dialogue
entries.evidence: Fact search exists; history experiments use a bounded reader and source-guarded ranking. Reader considers newest 128 scoped completed pairs before exclusions.
entries.gap: Absent candidates cannot be recovered by a better selector; larger-scale recovery is separate.
entries.next_check: Measure required-source availability before evaluating ranking or answers.

entries.name: Evidence selection
entries.input: Fixed candidate pool and current question
entries.output: Chosen original source IDs, not canonical facts or an answer
entries.evidence: Literal selection is measured; D04 loses an available antecedent. Neighborhood and joint model selection remain proposed, unimplemented.
entries.gap: Material corrections/references can be omitted; six prior model witnesses are not selector reliability evidence.
entries.next_check: Map existing benchmark tasks to this boundary before adding custom semantic cases.

entries.name: Context delivery
entries.input: Policy-specific facts, recent dialogue, optional summary and selected historical records, with consumer budgets and source bindings
entries.output: Attributed evidence fitted into actual generation/reviewer inputs; runtime separately composes bound characterization and ADE-wide requirements
entries.evidence: Typed, natural and historical consumers receive different evidence. Current history admission is greedy; history probes bind supplied H. Exact whole-selection admission remains proposed in ADR 0060. See the audit's policy-specific input table.
entries.gap: Joint selections need a reviewed preservation contract; construction success does not prove semantic sufficiency.
entries.next_check: Compare selected IDs with actual generation/reviewer H, fit outcomes and source-loss receipts.

entries.name: Source capture
entries.input: Accepted user input and eventual candidate/committed reply
entries.output: Original messages, roles, hashes and run outcomes
entries.evidence: Input is persisted at acceptance before generation; completed assistant message is finalized later. Recording is not fact acceptance.
entries.gap: Failed/pending input must not masquerade as a completed exchange.
entries.next_check: Trace accepted, cancelled, failed and completed turns without losing outcome attribution.

entries.name: Memory update review
entries.input: Typed: current user, up to eight prior user messages, active facts and entities; no candidate reply. Natural variants: policy-specific originals/lifecycle state plus reference-only candidate. Historical H is supplied only by the bound experimental history path.
entries.output: Supported proposed factual changes or no change
entries.evidence: One bound-policy reviewer owns semantic interpretation (PC-05); natural variants replace typed review and remain experimental. See the audit's policy-specific input table. A valid citation is not semantic proof.
entries.gap: Scope omissions, unsupported targets and output exhaustion remain observed limitations.
entries.next_check: Score false/missed updates and unjustified clarification against source-grounded expectations.

entries.name: Validation and commit
entries.input: Prepared review, source/version bindings and accepted generations
entries.output: Atomic permitted memory, assistant, summary and terminal run changes
entries.evidence: Structural validation, locks and finalization exist; ADE does not reinterpret meaning here (PC-05/07).
entries.gap: Atomicity cannot repair a semantically wrong but structurally valid proposal.
entries.next_check: Check source/version drift and all-or-nothing assistant/memory finalization independently of reviewer quality.

entries.name: Index maintenance
entries.input: Prepared fact changes and embedding-space identity
entries.output: Revision-linked searchable representations committed with the facts
entries.evidence: Fact embeddings are prepared before finalization, persisted atomically and bound to revisions/space; no general persistent dialogue graph is implied.
entries.gap: Fresh/current representations still need retrieval-quality assessment.
entries.next_check: Verify obsolete revisions and incompatible embedding spaces cannot surface as current facts.

entries.name: Conversation compaction
entries.input: Older local messages and current context pressure
entries.output: Source-linked versioned summary proposal and working context
entries.evidence: Existing compaction is not a future optional addition. Its summary proposal is prepared before generation and finalized with the turn.
entries.gap: A summary is not independent factual authority or proof of source-level recall.
entries.next_check: Compare source qualifiers with supplied summaries and count meaningful omissions.

entries.name: Additional derived views
entries.input: Source-linked committed records, if an extension is justified
entries.output: Optional compact view, not a new truth store
entries.evidence: Placeholder for possible timelines/consolidated views; not implemented or approved. Existing summaries remain MEM-09.
entries.gap: No demonstrated need for another derived representation (PC-09).
entries.next_check: Reopen only after measured search/context gaps justify its maintenance and distortion costs.

entries.name: Conversation workspace
entries.input: User messages, selections and run events
entries.output: Session lifecycle, replies, cancellation and state refresh
entries.evidence: Browser owns presentation; providers are accessed only behind ADE API. The controller owns displayed state and selection/read epochs; its local monitor owns stream/poll lifecycle and guarded completion.
entries.gap: A working UI is not evidence of personality or historical-recall quality.
entries.next_check: Follow one immutable version/subject selection through an asynchronous turn.

entries.name: Memory and lineage display
entries.input: Subject facts, revisions, source links and conversation summaries
entries.output: Operator-visible state and explicit lifecycle actions
entries.evidence: Facts and conversation binding are exposed explicitly; removal is an operator action, not a conversational consent feature (PC-06/07).
entries.gap: Displayed fact state must not hide terminal lifecycle outcomes.
entries.next_check: Match UI state to committed lineage after correct/end/remove operations.

entries.name: Turn activity inspection
entries.input: Retained dispatch, tool and context metadata
entries.output: Observed counts, admitted IDs, source-chat links and incompleteness labels
entries.evidence: Existing inspector reports evidence availability, not causal model thinking. It is not a full candidate-to-packet trace.
entries.gap: Candidate, selected and delivered source differences are not all visible here.
entries.next_check: Inventory missing boundary artifacts before extending this view.

entries.name: Private evaluation artifact inspection
entries.input: Bounded development/evaluation captures and readbacks
entries.output: Inspectable source/state/packet evidence with explicit unavailable states
entries.evidence: Isolated capture exists; full artifacts are private and not a newly implemented public inspection UI.
entries.gap: Inspection has to preserve access, capture limits and missing-evidence distinctions.
entries.next_check: Trace an already-recorded case across candidate, selection, actual packet and commit evidence.

entries.name: Prompt and persona editor
entries.input: Operator content edits
entries.output: Reviewed authoring requests and rendered content state
entries.evidence: Prompt Center edits content, not running agents or providers.
entries.gap: Authoring changes do not rewrite already-bound conversation versions.
entries.next_check: Verify editor state and immutable runtime binding remain distinct.

entries.name: Model catalog interface
entries.input: Canonical model options and scenario selections
entries.output: User-visible model/capability selection
entries.evidence: The backend catalog adapts Model Router identity rather than inventing another model registry.
entries.gap: Availability and selected-route qualification are not equivalent.
entries.next_check: Check displayed options against canonical identities and release-qualified selections.

entries.name: Schema editor
entries.input: Reviewed label-schema edits
entries.output: Schema authoring UI and validated schema records
entries.evidence: Existing schema tooling supports the adjacent Label Lab; it is not a character memory schema redesign.
entries.gap: Keep task schemas distinct from native memory contracts.
entries.next_check: Trace a label-schema edit through its own owning feature.

entries.name: Test Center and artifact viewer
entries.input: Named workflow launches and rooted run artifacts
entries.output: Run state, cancellation and bounded artifact presentation
entries.evidence: Maintains three named workflows; private character-development workflows are not automatically registered here.
entries.gap: UI launchability is not behavior or release acceptance.
entries.next_check: Check artifact provenance and rooted access before adding a new inspection capability.

entries.name: Dashboard and documentation
entries.input: Feature routes and maintained documentation
entries.output: Workspace navigation and feature reading surfaces
entries.evidence: Existing feature homes are registered; this inventory did not qualify navigation behavior anew.
entries.gap: Documentation and navigation must not present experimental behavior as released.
entries.next_check: Cross-check links and status language against the current contracts.

entries.name: External information and actions
entries.input: A future concrete, permitted outside-information/action request
entries.output: Actual outside result for Character to interpret
entries.evidence: No generic external tool platform is proposed. Memory search is CHAR-05/MEM-02; synthetic weather/failure tools are evaluation fixtures.
entries.gap: A concrete capability and execution/authority contract are required before expansion.
entries.next_check: Reopen for a named user need, not because this placeholder exists.

entries.name: Turn orchestration and worker
entries.input: Accepted run, deadline, lease and immutable bindings
entries.output: One coordinated attempt, tools/review, cancellation/retry and final outcome
entries.evidence: Owns sequencing and atomic finalization; capability boxes are not independent post-reply hooks (PC-08/09).
entries.gap: The chart is not a deployment or retry-policy change.
entries.next_check: Trace acceptance through failure/cancellation/success with existing receipts.

entries.name: PostgreSQL and migrations
entries.input: Transactions, schema migrations and locked identities
entries.output: Native state, revisions, summaries, runs and events
entries.evidence: PostgreSQL is native state authority; persona authoring SQLite is separate from immutable runtime snapshots.
entries.gap: Storage correctness is not semantic memory correctness.
entries.next_check: Verify schema and transaction invariants using isolated database tests.

entries.name: Model Router and catalog adapters
entries.input: Canonical route, capability profile and request
entries.output: One-attempt provider response or explicit failure
entries.evidence: Router owns identity/discovery/forwarding; ADE owns turn retry and product behavior.
entries.gap: Provider availability does not qualify persona or memory behavior.
entries.next_check: Verify request/profile identity independently of product scoring.

entries.name: Evaluation workflows and fixtures
entries.input: Tracked fixtures, explicit environment binding and any separately authorized run
entries.output: Offline checks, diagnostic artifacts or exact qualification evidence
entries.evidence: Offline, private replay, live diagnosis and release gates remain distinct. This map launches none of them.
entries.gap: Reuse of named public memory benchmarks has not yet been mapped to these boundaries.
entries.next_check: Map reusable tasks to subsystem measures; keep only uncovered ADE regression cases.

entries.name: Dispatch and source observations
entries.input: Actual boundary events and bounded evaluation capture
entries.output: Counts, completeness, hashes, omission receipts and before/after state
entries.evidence: Public metadata and restricted full-state capture have different access and completeness contracts; neither exposes private model reasoning.
entries.gap: Observed availability cannot identify which source caused a reply.
entries.next_check: Distinguish unavailable, truncated and observed-empty boundary artifacts.

entries.name: Release gates, smoke and recovery
entries.input: Exact source/build/policy identity and approved evidence
entries.output: Release decision, operational checks and documented rollback
entries.evidence: Gate machinery exists; this inventory neither checks live deployment nor qualifies changed policies.
entries.gap: Historical qualification cannot be inherited by new source/policy hashes.
entries.next_check: Audit exact ledger bindings only when a release decision is requested.

entries.name: App composition and authentication
entries.input: Same-origin requests and server-side configuration/credentials
entries.output: Composed product API and authenticated feature access
entries.evidence: Application wiring and credential handling retain their existing platform owner.
entries.gap: Not every infrastructure concern is a Character or Memory module.
entries.next_check: Keep public feature contracts and server-only credentials at their existing boundaries.

entries.name: Reviewed task schemas
entries.input: Reviewed schema edits and Label Lab selection
entries.output: Validated task schemas through Schema Center's public contract
entries.evidence: Schema Center and its content registry exist; task-label schemas are not Memory facts.
entries.gap: Task schema evolution must not silently change native memory contracts.
entries.next_check: Trace schema identity through the owning task instead of the character-memory pipeline.

entries.name: Comment Lab
entries.input: Task-specific comment, persona and model options
entries.output: Router-backed comment result under the lab contract
entries.evidence: Independent existing feature, not silently reassigned to the character-memory runtime.
entries.gap: This inventory does not re-evaluate its task behavior.
entries.next_check: Use its owning workflow if Comment Lab work is requested.

entries.name: Label Lab
entries.input: Task text, selected schema and model options
entries.output: Validated labeling result under the lab contract
entries.evidence: Independent existing feature using Schema Center and Model Catalog; not character conversational behavior.
entries.gap: This inventory does not re-evaluate labeling quality.
entries.next_check: Use its own task cases rather than character-memory fixtures.

records.name: Original dialogue
records.authority: Evidence of what was said, with roles and run outcomes; not automatic fact acceptance

records.name: Facts and revisions
records.authority: Maintained subject-owned state, lifecycle, sources and revisions

records.name: Conversation summaries
records.authority: Source-linked versioned working context; not independent factual authority

records.name: Definition snapshots
records.authority: Immutable prompt/persona/deployment/policy binding for a conversation

records.name: Fact search representations
records.authority: Revision/space-linked derived access, not a second truth store

records.name: Runs, attempts and events
records.authority: Observed processing/outcome metadata; completeness must be stated

flows.name: Recall and respond
flows.note: Memory supplies evidence; Character interprets the exchange and chooses and expresses a response. CHAR-03/04 share generation with no materialized handoff. PC-12's assessment lenses are not pipeline stages. History branches are experimental, not universally active.
steps: Read eligible facts and bounded history
Build actual requests with persona and recent context
Interpret the exchange and evidence; choose and express the reply within shared generation

flows.name: Review and retain
flows.note: Input capture precedes generation; eligible compaction is prepared before generation. Typed review excludes the candidate reply; experimental natural review receives it as reference only. Fact embeddings are prepared before finalization; assistant, permitted changes and any summary are committed atomically.
steps: Capture original input and attribution at acceptance
Prepare eligible compaction before generating the candidate reply
Review supported factual changes using the bound policy's inputs and current user authority
Validate and atomically finalize the reply and permitted state changes

flows.name: Coordinate and inspect
flows.note: Runtime coordinates these responsibilities; Model Router owns provider access; PostgreSQL owns native state. Observations show boundary artifacts, not hidden thinking. External tools and additional views remain deferred.
steps: Runtime accepts, leases and coordinates one attempt
Model Router forwards explicit requests without hidden turn retries
PostgreSQL finalizes native state through the runtime
Modules emit bounded observations with completeness labels
Interface and workflows inspect the actual available artifacts
